owner_context: Selina Li course final; distinct from hospital data-entry work
publication_status: local only; no push, PR, or merge

source.name: Hospitalized patients with heart failure: integrating electronic healthcare records and external outcome data
source.setting: Zigong Fourth People's Hospital, Sichuan, China; retrospective, December 2016 to June 2019
source.access: Published research dataset with restricted file access and data-use agreement on current PhysioNet page; local authorized CSV used, raw rows excluded from Git
source.same_input_evidence: Two local CSV copies have identical hash; fresh run matches September's dimensions, outcome counts and main top-k death counts, but September's private data hash is unavailable.
source.release_version_issue: Local 167-column CSV includes an extra index and a 166-row dictionary; current PhysioNet v1.3 page describes 168 variables. Exact download release not established.

methods.baseline_tuning: Five inner stratified CV folds; AP objective; LR 14 candidates and RF 30 sampled candidates; five outer folds for nested CV, all on train partition
methods.neural_network: 32/16 shared dense units, dropout 0.50/0.30, L2, 3-month class weighting, validation early stopping; no nested CV
methods.thresholds: F1 grid search on validation partition only; test labels used only for evaluation
methods.equal_capacity: Top ceil(0.05/0.10/0.20 * 402) = 21/41/81 per model; exploratory project choices, not advisor-prescribed or clinical thresholds
methods.primary_metric_definition: AP via sklearn average_precision_score; historical PR_AUC columns use AP

previously_completed_on_2026_09_23.key_interpretation: Identical recall and precision at equal capacity can conceal different flagged individuals and different detected deaths.

newly_completed_on_2026_10_01.fresh_rerun: Two current local CSV copies are byte-identical; the rerun agrees with September's reported sample, outcome and main top-k detection counts. September's private manifest is unavailable, so historical input-byte identity and row membership are unverified. Minor RF score and overlap changes occurred under different package versions.
newly_completed_on_2026_10_01.paired_bootstrap: 2000 requested, 1999 valid paired resamples of fixed test rows; RF-NN AP difference 95% percentile interval [-0.0230, 0.3631]; conditional and exploratory
newly_completed_on_2026_10_01.feature_timing_sensitivity: 134 documented admission/day-one source fields; same split, previous train-selected baseline hyperparameters, new fit and validation thresholds; not retuned nested CV

interpretation_limits: Only eight observed test deaths; one case shifts recall by 12.5 percentage points.
The test split had been inspected previously; this is exploratory, not independent confirmation.
No external validation, calibration, prospective admission-time guarantee, or clinical intervention study.
Unique row IDs and nonmissing mortality labels do not prove unique patients or complete follow-up.
Two discharge-related death fields disagree on seven rows, including five destination=Died records with three-month death label 0; do not relabel without source adjudication.
The timing sensitivity reuses selected baseline hyperparameters and has no new nested CV; apparent RF gain is not validated superiority.
No fairness or causal claim is supported.
private_outputs: comparison_results/ contains fitted models, row-level predictions, executed notebook, and row-position manifest; all ignored by Git
